nodes.title: Packs travel outside the box
nodes.text: Flight packs ride in a LiPo bag (E2), not in the box; the aircraft in the box is the gate mass less one pack
nodes.basis: LiPo transport practice (E2 owns); keeps the loaded box under 6 kg

nodes.title: Design drop is flat on the floor
nodes.text: The 0.3 m sill drop is designed for a flat floor impact; side, end and corner impacts are checked by test only
nodes.basis: a box slipping off a sill lands on its floor or a bottom edge; edge drops rotate the box and load less (ISTA practice)

nodes.title: Lid pillars stop the rebound before the upper tube ends reach the lid
nodes.text: After the floor drop the aircraft rebounds into the two PE hold-down pillars; they arrest it before the upper tube ends and foot pads close the 10 mm static gap to the bare lid shell, so the lid needs no lining
nodes.basis: EST: rebound at e = 0.5 from 2.43 m/s gives ~1.1 J on 2.05 kg; two 100 x 60 mm PE pillars ~0.23 m tall at ~40 kPa over 15 mm (5 preload + 10 gap) store ~3.6 J (3x). T-D7-BOX-DROP checks it: chalk on the upper motor caps, no mark on the lid

nodes.title: Cradle crush column: stroke, load factor, free travel
nodes.equation: s_use = eps_use t ; n_T = 1 + h / (eta s_use) ; s_bottom = eps_bottom t ; travel_req = s_bottom + margin ; t_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1) eps_use)

nodes.title: Box stack-up: height needed, clearances, drop allowed by the 0.50 m box
nodes.equation: floor = shell + doubler ; lid = shell + lining ; H_req = floor + travel_req + env_z + gap_min + lid ; travel = H - floor - lid - env_z - gap_min ; clear_bottoming = travel - s_bottom ; nose_gap = W - 2 shell - env_x - aft_gap - nose_pad (- nose_ext) ; x_clear = min(nose_gap_ext, aft_gap) ; tip_to_pad = (L - 2 shell - env_y) / 2 - pad ; A1 box: t_max = (travel_A1 - margin) / eps_bottom, h_allow = (n_allow - 1) eta eps_use t_max

nodes.title: Cradle saddle and pillar footprint against C2 and the brace anchors
nodes.equation: A_saddle = w (x1 - x0 - relief) ; side_min = min(w, x1 - x0, hx, hy) ; gap_brace = y_anchor - (y_c + max(w, hy, fy) / 2)

Box mass and loaded mass
nodes.equation: shell = areal (1 + flaps) [L W + 2 (L + W)(H - t) + L W + 2 (L + W) lip] ; box = shell + doublers + lining + end and nose pads + cradles + tray + straps + handles + backing + corners + consumables ; loaded = box + (gate - pack) + spare props + pouch

nodes.title: Field set-up time, closed box to the arm check

steps: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (pillars come with it); unfold the mat upwind, rubber up
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its four feet on the mat; glance at the four replace-mark grooves
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, colour-matched to the motor (LH nut on the CW motors), 10 mm spanner
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes, tip cover off
TX on (before the pack, flight card)
take a pack from the battery can, seat it at the trim mark, strap it
close the AS150U pack plug, FC boots

nodes.title: Off-axis drops: drop height each face allows, lid-pillar bearing
nodes.equation: h_end = (nY - 1) eta eps_use t_endpad ; h_nose = (nX - 1) eta eps_use t_nosepad ; F_feet = 2 (F_up + F_lo) ; n_aft = F_feet / (m g) ; h_aft = F_feet s_foot / (m g) - aft_gap - s_foot ; h_lid = (nLid - 1) eta gap_top ; p_pillar = F_pillar / (a b) ; p_allow = sigma_xps / SF

nodes.title: The three carried items and who carries what
nodes.equation: mat = A (ply + rubber) + hinge ; can = can + n_packs (m_pack + bag) ; tote = tote + tx + spares ; two people: A = box + tote (shoulder), B = can + mat (one per hand) ; one person: two trips ; item_max = max(can, mat, tote)

nodes.title: Crush-column coupon test
nodes.procedure: Two 60 x 50 x 120 mm PE columns under a 2.05 kg dummy on a saddle; drop 0.3 m onto concrete, phone accelerometer on the dummy (>= 400 Hz app); 1.7 and 2.2 pcf; pick the lower peak

nodes.title: Loaded box drop
nodes.procedure: Ballasted spar-and-tube dummy with real feet first, then the aircraft. 0.3 m flat drop and one bottom-edge drop; then the off-axis faces at their CL-D7-*-DROP-ALLOW heights (end, front, aft, lid-down), dummy only; accelerometer taped on the spar at y 0; chalk on the motor caps, foot pads, pod nose and wingtips (no mark on floor, lid or walls except the pads)

Handle pull test
nodes.procedure: Loaded box hung from each handle in turn for 1 min, then jerked 3 times from 50 mm slack; no pull-through, no dent
